aggressive_definition: Prostate cancer mortality, including a reported analysis among White participants.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Notably, higher diet quality measured by DASH was associated with lower colorectal (HR = 0.79; 95% CI: 0.65, 0.97) and prostate cancer mortality (HR = 0.56; 95% CI: 0.38, 0.83) among White participants.
reason: The study analyzed prostate cancer incidence and prostate cancer mortality in a prospective cohort. The abstract reports 84,507 adults enrolled in the parent SCCS but does not give the final analytic participant count, prostate cancer incidence count, or prostate cancer mortality count.

estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied row corresponds to incident prostate cancer. Its reciprocal values reflect an inverted orientation of the full-text incidence estimate, but the endpoint remains general incident prostate cancer.
